LESSON: SOIL (EXPLORING SOIL - CLASSIFICATION OF SOILS)

Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade two
Subject: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
Strand: Natural Environment
Topic 2.2: Soil (exploring soil - classification of soils)
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 8

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Soil (exploring soil - classification of soils), part of Natural Environment in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade two ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES.

Key inquiry question: How can you identify different types of soil in our environment?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Soil (exploring soil - classification of soils) together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Values:
● Unity: Learners develop cooperation skills as they model objects (balls, ribbons, pots) with different types of soil (clay loam, sand) in

groups.

● Responsibility: Learners develop a sense of responsibility when cleaning working area after modelling ribbons with soil

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
● Health Promotion Issues: Health and hygiene skills are developed by learners as washing hands with soap and clean running water after

playing with soil to prevent communicable diseases.

● Mental health: Social awareness skills are developed by learners as they use common courteous words and observe game rules when

playing with soil.

Link to other Learning Areas:

● Creative Arts: Different types of soil help learners develop modelling skills.
